blocks.h2: Toilet Problems We Fix in Elmhurst

tiles.body: A worn flapper or a fill valve clogged with scale.
An older toilet or a main line problem.

blocks.intro: Hard water and older plumbing affect toilets too.

items.body: Mineral buildup keeps valves from shutting off.
Cast iron flanges in postwar homes corrode.

blocks.h2: What Happens When You Call J. Blanton

steps.body: Tank, bowl, seal, flange and line.

img.alt: J. Blanton plumber in shoe covers on a home's front steps with a sewer camera

blocks.body: If you're replacing a toilet, a few choices matter. Comfort height is easier for many adults. An elongated bowl is more comfortable but needs more space. Check the rough-in, the distance from the wall to the bolts, which is usually 12 inches. Modern toilets use far less water per flush than older ones and still clear well. We'll help you choose one that fits.

blocks.h2: What Affects the Price of Toilet Work
blocks.body: A flapper or fill valve is a quick repair. Resetting a toilet on a new seal takes a little longer. A damaged flange or a soft subfloor adds work. A new toilet depends on the model and whether you supply it. We look first, explain the options and quote a flat price.

items.q: Why does my toilet keep running?
items.preview: A flapper or a scaled fill valve.
items.answer: Usually a worn flapper or a fill valve that scale keeps from closing.

items.q: Should I replace an old toilet?
items.preview: If it clogs or leaks often, usually.
items.answer: If it clogs, cracks or keeps needing repairs, replacing it is usually better.

items.q: Why is there water around the base?
items.answer: Usually a failed wax ring, sometimes from a loose toilet.

items.q: Can you install a toilet I bought?
items.answer: Yes, with a new seal, bolts and supply line.

items.preview: The distance from the wall to the drain.
items.answer: The distance from the finished wall to the center of the drain, usually 12 inches.

items.q: Why does my toilet sweat in summer?
items.preview: Cold tank water and humid air.
items.answer: Cold water in the tank meets humid air and condenses. An insulated tank liner or a mixing valve can help.

items.q: Can you move a toilet during a remodel?
items.answer: Often, depending on the floor and drain location. We'll check before you plan the layout.

items.q: How much does toilet repair cost in Elmhurst?
items.preview: It depends on the problem. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on what's wrong and whether you're repairing or replacing. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
